name: Restart notice
packageArguments: Optional. {"Message":"<notice text, no double quotes>","SnoozeMinutes":"60","PromptMinutes":"10","CountdownMinutes":"15","ReportOnly":"false"}. ReportOnly "true" only detects and writes the device field relianSessionState (userPresent, reason, users, sessions, pending, lastBoot, build, snooze, timestamp); no notice, no restart. Base64 of the JSON goes in the runner's -PackageArguments. Without it the defaults above apply.
